'''Ord Bueri''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="CEO">{{CSWECite|II|419|Ord}} states that the term «[[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]]» and the abbreviation «Ord» applied to certain [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].</ref> located in the [[Ord Bueri system/Legends|eponymous star system]], a part of the [[Nilgaard sector/Legends|Nilgaard sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In the [[Pius Dea Era]], a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] that lasted between [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]] and [[11,000 BBY]],<ref name="EGTW" /> this planet served as a frontier [[Colonist/Legends|outpost]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="CEO" /> to protect [[Human/Legends|human]] colonists in the region.<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Such planets were denoted as [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]], and many of them from that era of expansion retained the prefix «Ord» in their names.<ref name="CEO" /><ref name="EA" />

Around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Ord Bueri was a source of [[H-60 Tempest bomber/Legends|H-60 Tempest bombers]] sent to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Great Temple/Legends|base]] at [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], where the bombers were kept partially dismantled.<ref name="IWSW">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref><ref name="CEB">{{CSWECite|II|419|Ord Bueri}}</ref> During the [[Nagai–Tof War]], shortly before the [[Second Battle of Endor]], the leaders of the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] lost contact with units on [[Champala/Legends|Champala]], Ord Bueri, and [[Koda Space Station]], but the return of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] with [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|reinforcements]] to [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] helped repel the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] invasion.<ref name="HS">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/nagai11202009/index.html|text=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs|int=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ord Bueri was first mentioned in the [[2004]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]'', authored by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="IWSW" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], placed the Ord Bueri system, and therefore the world itself, in grid square S-5.<ref name="EA" />
